label: SYNTHETIC
note: The pack manifest of the fintech pack (PCK-02, ruling A333; settles the hash-pin of EVD-06, A320). It lists each pack file the core loads with its SHA-256 and names the evidence-mapping id and the reconciliation rule-set id the core expects, so the core hard-codes neither (INV-14). The core loads through it and refuses a mismatch. A path is relative to the pack directory (packs/). `expected` ids are `<id>@<version>` exactly as the file carries them (mapping_id and version, ruleset_id and version). Every file of a listed kind must be listed: an unlisted file is a packcheck failure. Hash-pinned now, signatures later (A320). Any edit to a listed file needs its SHA-256 updated here, in the same pull request: `sha256sum <file>` gives it. The action graphs the pack names (`action_graph_files`) are listed with kind `action_graph`, one entry each (A510, version 2): no graph is served unless it is pinned here, and a pinned graph the pack does not name is refused. The limits files of the pack (`fintech/limits/*.json`, kind `limits`, A544 interim, version 3) are pinned too, every file of the folder: a limit is data a Founder reviews (AGENT-16), so one changed after CI refuses the pack. The injection-screen patterns are listed with kind `injection_patterns` and `expected.injection_patterns_id` (A645, version 4): required, exactly one file, from manifest version 4; a manifest below version 4 lists none or one, and a manifest that lists none carries no pattern data (A664, interim). The priority routing member (kind `priority_routing`, at most one; PCK-09, ruling A644, interim, relayed, not yet committed) is pinned too: the priority and owner queue of each SLA phase, read by the evaluator. It is additive and carries no version gate, so a manifest of the earlier kinds is still valid. Not yet listed (no consumer yet): lexicons, templates, schemas.
